title: Little Learners — Grade 1 Content Foundation

curriculumLevel.positioning: Primary-school practice companion; align pacing to the child's school syllabus and local curriculum.

learningPrinciples: Short, concrete lessons with one main idea at a time.
Use familiar, child-safe examples from home, school and the local environment.
Give supportive feedback and explain why an answer is correct.
Treat mistakes as part of learning; avoid shame, speed pressure and public rankings.
Keep English and Hindi learning strands distinct while allowing bilingual navigation.
Have an adult adapt difficulty and check that examples fit the child's curriculum.

lessons.title: Alphabet and letter sounds
lessons.concept: Letters have names and sounds. Vowels are a, e, i, o and u; the other letters are consonants.

questions.prompt: Which letter begins the word sun?
questions.explanation: Sun begins with the /s/ sound.

questions.prompt: Which one is a vowel?
questions.explanation: E is one of the five vowels.

questions.prompt: Which word begins with the /m/ sound?
questions.explanation: Map begins with the letter m.

lessons.title: Short vowel words
lessons.concept: Short vowel sounds help us read short words such as cat, bed, sit, hot and sun.

questions.prompt: Which word rhymes with cat?
questions.explanation: Cat and hat share the ending sound.

questions.prompt: Choose the word with a short i sound.
questions.explanation: Pin has the short i sound.

questions.prompt: Which word completes this sentence? I sleep in a ___.
questions.explanation: A bed is where we sleep.

lessons.title: Naming words and action words
lessons.concept: Naming words name people, places, animals or things. Action words tell what someone or something does.

questions.prompt: Which is a naming word?
questions.explanation: Teacher names a person.

questions.prompt: Which word shows an action?
questions.explanation: Jump tells what someone can do.

questions.prompt: Choose the action word: Birds ___ in the sky.
questions.explanation: Fly describes an action.

lessons.title: Build a simple sentence
lessons.concept: A sentence tells a complete idea. Begin with a capital letter and finish with a full stop, question mark or exclamation mark.

questions.prompt: Which sentence is written correctly?
questions.explanation: It starts with a capital letter and ends with a full stop.

questions.prompt: Which mark usually ends a question?
questions.explanation: A question mark ends a question.

questions.prompt: Choose the best word: I ___ a story.
questions.explanation: Read makes a meaningful sentence.

lessons.title: स्वर पहचानें
lessons.concept: हिंदी के मुख्य स्वर हैं: अ, आ, इ, ई, उ, ऊ, ऋ, ए, ऐ, ओ, औ. इन्हें पहचानें और बोलकर अभ्यास करें।

questions.prompt: इनमें से स्वर कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: आ एक स्वर है।

questions.prompt: 'अनार' किस अक्षर से शुरू होता है?
questions.explanation: अनार का पहला अक्षर अ है।

questions.prompt: इनमें से कौन-सा स्वर है?
questions.explanation: ई एक स्वर है।

lessons.title: व्यंजन पहचानें
lessons.concept: क, ख, ग, घ, च, ज, ट, ड, त, द, प, ब, म, य, र, ल, व, स, ह जैसे अक्षर व्यंजन हैं।

questions.prompt: इनमें से व्यंजन कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: क एक व्यंजन है।

questions.prompt: 'मछली' किस अक्षर से शुरू होता है?
questions.explanation: मछली का पहला अक्षर म है।

questions.prompt: 'कमल' का पहला अक्षर क्या है?
questions.explanation: कमल क से शुरू होता है।

lessons.title: मात्रा वाले शब्द
lessons.concept: मात्राएँ स्वर की ध्वनि को व्यंजन के साथ जोड़ती हैं। उदाहरण: का, कि, की, कु, कू, के, कै, को, कौ।

questions.prompt: 'की' में कौन-सी मात्रा है?
questions.explanation: की में ई की मात्रा (ी) है।

questions.prompt: किस शब्द में 'ा' की मात्रा है?
questions.explanation: राम में आ की मात्रा है।

questions.prompt: 'फूल' में कौन-सी मात्रा है?
questions.explanation: फूल में ऊ की मात्रा (ू) है।

lessons.title: सरल वाक्य
lessons.concept: छोटे वाक्य पढ़ें और उनका अर्थ समझें। उदाहरण: यह फल है। राम घर जाता है। मैं पानी पीता/पीती हूँ।

questions.prompt: 'गाय घास खाती है।' कौन घास खाती है?
questions.explanation: वाक्य में गाय घास खाती है।

questions.prompt: पानी पीने के लिए क्या उपयोग करते हैं?
questions.explanation: हम गिलास से पानी पी सकते हैं।

questions.prompt: 'यह ___ है।' सही शब्द चुनें: 🍎
questions.explanation: यह सेब है।

lessons.title: Numbers to 100
lessons.concept: Count forward and backward, read number names, and understand tens and ones. For example, 34 has 3 tens and 4 ones.

questions.prompt: What number comes after 39?
questions.explanation: After 39 comes 40.

questions.prompt: How many tens are in 46?
questions.explanation: 46 has 4 tens and 6 ones.

questions.prompt: Which number is smallest?
questions.explanation: 27 is less than 37 and 72.

lessons.title: Addition within 20
lessons.concept: Addition joins groups. Count on from the larger number, use objects, or draw dots to find the total.

questions.explanation: Seven and five make twelve.

questions.prompt: There are 6 red balls and 3 blue balls. How many balls altogether?
questions.explanation: 6 + 3 = 9 balls.
Ten plus four equals fourteen.

lessons.title: Subtraction within 20
lessons.concept: Subtraction means taking away or finding how many are left. Count backward or cross out objects.

questions.explanation: Take four away from nine; five remain.

questions.prompt: There are 12 mangoes. You eat 2. How many are left?

questions.explanation: Fifteen minus five equals ten.

lessons.title: Shapes and patterns
lessons.concept: A circle is round, a triangle has 3 sides, a square has 4 equal sides, and a rectangle has 4 sides. Patterns repeat in a rule.

questions.prompt: Which shape has 3 sides?
questions.explanation: A triangle has three sides.

questions.prompt: What comes next: red, blue, red, blue, ___?
questions.explanation: The pattern repeats red, blue.

questions.prompt: Which shape has no corners?
questions.explanation: A circle has no corners.

strands.title: Environmental Studies
goals: Understand living things and their needs

lessons.title: Plants around us
lessons.concept: Plants need sunlight, air, water and nutrients to grow. Roots take in water, stems support the plant, and leaves help it make food.

questions.prompt: Which part usually takes in water from the soil?
questions.explanation: Roots absorb water and help anchor the plant.

questions.prompt: What does a seed often grow into?
questions.explanation: With suitable conditions, a seed can grow into a plant.

questions.prompt: Which does a plant need to grow?
questions.explanation: Plants need water, along with light, air and nutrients.

lessons.title: Animals and their homes
lessons.concept: Animals need food, water, air and shelter. Different animals live in different habitats, such as nests, burrows, ponds and forests.

questions.prompt: Which animal commonly lives in a nest?
questions.explanation: Many birds build nests for eggs and chicks.

questions.prompt: Which animal lives in water?
questions.explanation: Fish live in water and use gills to breathe.

questions.prompt: Why do animals need shelter?
questions.explanation: Shelter helps protect animals from danger and weather.

lessons.title: Our body and healthy habits
lessons.concept: Our senses help us explore the world. Washing hands, brushing teeth, eating a variety of foods, moving and sleeping support good health.

questions.prompt: Which body part helps us hear?
questions.explanation: We use our ears to hear sounds.

questions.prompt: When should we wash our hands?
options: Before eating and after using the toilet
questions.answer: Before eating and after using the toilet
questions.explanation: Handwashing helps remove germs.

questions.prompt: Which habit helps keep teeth clean?
questions.explanation: Brushing helps remove food and plaque.

lessons.title: Weather and seasons
lessons.concept: Weather can be sunny, rainy, cloudy or windy. We choose suitable clothing and habits for different weather conditions.

questions.prompt: What can help keep us dry in the rain?
questions.explanation: An umbrella helps shield us from rain.

questions.prompt: Which clothing is often useful on a cold day?
questions.explanation: A sweater helps keep the body warm.

questions.prompt: What do dark rain clouds often bring?
questions.explanation: Rain clouds can bring rainfall.

lessons.title: Sort and classify
lessons.concept: Objects can be grouped by a shared feature such as colour, shape, size, use or type.

questions.prompt: Which item belongs with apple, banana and mango?
questions.explanation: Orange is also a fruit.

questions.prompt: Which one is different: circle, square, triangle, carrot?
questions.explanation: Carrot is a vegetable; the others are shapes.

questions.prompt: Which pair belongs together?
questions.explanation: Both are utensils used for eating.

lessons.title: Complete the pattern
lessons.concept: Look for what repeats or changes. Patterns can use colours, shapes, numbers, sounds or movements.

questions.explanation: The numbers increase by 2 each time.

questions.prompt: star, heart, star, heart, __
questions.explanation: The two-shape pattern repeats.

questions.prompt: small, medium, large, small, medium, __
questions.explanation: The size sequence repeats.

lessons.title: Compare and observe
lessons.concept: Careful observation helps us describe what is the same, what is different, and what may happen next.

questions.prompt: Which is heavier in everyday use: a school bag full of books or one pencil?
questions.explanation: A bag full of books usually weighs more than one pencil.

questions.prompt: You see puddles and wet roads after dark clouds. What likely happened?
questions.explanation: Rain often leaves puddles and wet roads.

questions.prompt: Which is a good way to compare two leaves?
options: Look at their shape and size
questions.answer: Look at their shape and size
questions.explanation: Observing visible features helps us compare.

lessons.title: Kind words and manners
lessons.concept: Use polite words, listen when others speak, take turns, and treat people with respect.

questions.prompt: What can you say when someone helps you?
questions.explanation: Thank you shows appreciation.

questions.prompt: Two children want the same toy. What is a fair choice?
questions.explanation: Taking turns gives everyone a chance.

questions.prompt: You accidentally bump into someone. What should you do?
options: Say sorry and check they are okay
questions.answer: Say sorry and check they are okay
questions.explanation: Apologising and showing care is respectful.

lessons.title: Safety at home and outside
lessons.concept: Follow trusted adult guidance, use road crossings carefully, never touch unknown medicines or dangerous objects, and ask for help when unsure.

questions.prompt: Before crossing a road with an adult, what should you do?
questions.explanation: Pause and follow the adult's safe crossing instructions.

questions.prompt: You find an unknown tablet on the floor. What should you do?
options: Do not touch it; tell a trusted adult
questions.answer: Do not touch it; tell a trusted adult
questions.explanation: Unknown medicines can be dangerous.

questions.prompt: If you feel unsafe or lost, who should you seek?
options: A trusted adult or appropriate helper
A stranger who asks for secrets
questions.answer: A trusted adult or appropriate helper
questions.explanation: Ask a trusted adult or clearly identified helper for support.

lessons.title: Taking care of myself and my things
lessons.concept: Small routines—packing a school bag, putting toys away, drinking water and asking for help—build independence.

questions.prompt: What should you do after playing with toys?
questions.explanation: Putting toys away keeps the space tidy and safer.

questions.prompt: What helps you remember your school items?
options: Check your timetable or bag list
questions.answer: Check your timetable or bag list
questions.explanation: A simple checklist helps you get ready.

questions.prompt: If you cannot do a school task yet, what can you do?
options: Try again and ask for help
questions.answer: Try again and ask for help
questions.explanation: Practice and support help us learn.

lessons.title: Family, school and community
lessons.concept: People in families, schools and communities help one another. Families can look different and deserve equal respect.

questions.prompt: Who helps children learn at school?
questions.explanation: Teachers support learning at school.

questions.prompt: Which place is used to borrow books?
questions.explanation: Libraries lend books and support reading.

questions.prompt: How can you help at home?
questions.explanation: Small helpful actions support everyone at home.

lessons.title: Community helpers
lessons.concept: Different people help communities, including doctors, nurses, farmers, firefighters, cleaners, drivers and shopkeepers.

questions.prompt: Who helps care for sick people?
questions.explanation: Doctors and nurses help people stay healthy.

questions.prompt: Who grows many of the crops we eat?
questions.explanation: Farmers grow crops and help produce food.

questions.prompt: Who helps put out dangerous fires?
questions.explanation: Firefighters are trained to respond to fires.

lessons.title: India and the natural world
lessons.concept: India has many languages, landscapes, festivals and traditions. We can appreciate differences and care for shared places.

questions.prompt: Which is a natural water body?
questions.explanation: A river is a natural flowing body of water.

questions.prompt: What is a respectful way to learn about another festival or tradition?
options: Say only one way is allowed
questions.explanation: Curiosity and respect help us learn from others.

questions.prompt: Which action helps keep a park clean?
questions.explanation: Using bins helps care for shared spaces.
